whatThisFileIs: A concrete, INACTIVE specification of ONE proposed face-neutral image call and of the exact contract and register additions a later owner decision would have to merge into origin/main before the send adapter can run. It authorises nothing. The send adapter never reads this file: it reads only the origin/main contract and register. Copying text from here into a working tree, a branch or an unmerged commit authorises nothing either (D-142 futureSendAuthorisationRule).

The call id and the claim identity embed the number; if the owner decision is given another number, the adapter and this file must be revised first.

prohibitions.noRetry: Exactly one fetch. No automatic or manual retry, no fallback request, no other model, and a redirect is never followed. Every consumed claim excludes a retry; a further attempt requires a NEW owner decision, a NEW call id and a NEW claim identity.
prohibitions.noPromotion: The call promotes nothing and writes no candidate file. Candidate status is a separate owner decision after the visual review, on the later approved underlay and with the later eyes and hair (D-159 productionOrderException).

toBeAddedByTheOwnerDecision.alsoRequiredInOriginMain: The D-142 and D-159 register rows exactly once each; meta.authorisesImageRequest false; the D-160 entry is the ONLY unspent entry; no spent call id reopened.

outputHandling.stored: the complete raw response body, every delivered image unchanged, the request id, the image count, every SHA-256, the request manifest and the attempt's event log
outputHandling.unexpectedImageCount: a count other than 1 is UNEXPECTED: everything is kept, nothing is selected, no check runs
outputHandling.technicalChecks: with exactly one image: D-159's binding checks (decode, master canvas, 8-bit RGBA, not empty, no alpha outside [384, 230, 632, 412]) and its diagnostics; a REJECT leaves no candidate
outputHandling.neverWritten: a candidate file; any crop, move, warp, matte removal or repair
